source.quote: September 30, 2026 December 31, 2025 September 30, 2025 ... Issued and paid shares (in thousands) 25,932,370 25,932,524 25,932,615 Shares awaiting retirement (in thousands) (5) - (91) Capital stock (in thousands) 25,932,365 25,932,524 25,932,524

notes: One class of common shares, priced on the primary Taiwan Stock Exchange line (2330.TW) in NT$ rather than the NYSE ADS (TSM, one ADS = five common shares). The count is 'Capital stock (in thousands)' at September 30, 2026 from the third-quarter consolidated report filed on Form 6-K, which excludes 5 thousand reclaimed restricted shares awaiting retirement; it is stated in thousands, so it is rounded to the nearest thousand shares. It is newer than the 20-F count (25,932,524,521 at February 28, 2026), and no buyback, split or tender has changed it materially.
